overview_description.description: The janitorial industry employs 2.5 million people in the US but lacks modern tools to help them thrive. The sector grapples with significant issues such as time theft and contract terminations due to the difficulty of maintaining high service quality. In the face of rising inflation costs and simultaneous financial pressures in the commercial real estate industry, the janitorial sector needs increased sophistication in job costing to thrive in the current economy. BrightGo creates modern end-to-end tools for these companies, including time and attendance, scheduling, inspections, job costing, and more, to help achieve business outcomes across operations, accounting, HR, and sales.

product.name: BrightGo Janitorial Operating System
product.description: A cloud-based platform providing operations and accounting tools tailored for building service contractors in the janitorial industry.

product.name: Operations Management Tools
product.description: Tools to manage scheduling, issue tracking, attendance, inspections, and communication for janitorial service operations.

product.name: Accounting and Payroll Integration
product.description: Features for timesheet review, payroll integration, missed punch management, job costing, and budget monitoring.

product.name: Timekeeping and Attendance Compliance
product.description: A system to ensure clock-in compliance and reduce time theft through automated notifications and escalation.

product.name: Quality Assurance System
product.description: An end-to-end system for conducting inspections, communicating results, and tracking issues to ensure service quality.

product.name: Operations Business Intelligence Dashboard
product.description: A dashboard providing real-time health scores of buildings to monitor operational performance and prioritize resources.
